correctness.rationale: For a full-rank Euclidean lattice in dimension two, a regular cut-locus Voronoi facet F_v identifies two closest lifts 0 and v. Their unit-distance gradients jump by j(x)=|v|/|x|; since F_v is centrally symmetric about v/2, parameter t along its length ell_v gives j²=|v|²/(|v|²/4+t²). Integrating from -ell_v/2 to ell_v/2 yields 4|v| atan(ell_v/|v|). Count only one facet from each opposite pair; triple intersections are H¹-null. For rectangular 2a by 2b torus, J_2=8a atan(b/a)+8b atan(a/b). At area A=4ab, writing r=b/a the normalized function is symmetric under r<->1/r, and its derivative strictly negative for r>1, so unique square maximum 2πsqrt(A).
